artifact.andruids-expansion.plaguetent.p:
{Plague Tent}

The Plague Tent afflicts your enemies with a disease and has a small chance to poison then.
The Plague Tent is a source of pestilence that eats away at your foes.
artifact.andruids-expansion.powerbond.bo: You pick up a small bone wrapped in green cloth. Upon closer inspection, it turns out to be a useful trinket. Give it to one stack of your troops.
You pick up a large bone wrapped in ornamental purple cloth. Upon closer inspection, it turns out to be a useful trinket. Give it to one stack of your troops.
You pick up a bone wrapped in red cloth. Upon closer inspection, it turns out to be a useful trinket. Give it to one stack of your troops.
hero.andruids-expansion.minotaur warlock: Sullivan was a devoted servant of Lord Alamar in Enroth and as a reward, his master began teaching him magic. Soon, his potential became apparent, and lust for even more power obscured former loyalties and sentiments. Now, Sullivan is a great Warlock and Alamar's fiercest rival.
Power unleashed by his powerbound creatures deals 3 damage instead of 2.
hero.andruids-expansion.plaguetent.bubon: Even alive, Doctor Bubonic was well aware that the difference between a potent remedy and deadly toxin lied simply in the dose. He crossed this treshold long ago and now, instead of curing people, he spreads his vicious diseases to further experiment on the victims' corpses.
Increases the duration and amount of the Plague Tent's debuffs.

Allied creatues have 30% chance to deal 2 damage (per crature) after each melee attack. Creatures that cast spells have 1 additional cast.

Allied creatues have 15% chance to deal 2 damage (per crature) after each melee attack. Creatures that cast spells have 1 additional cast.

{Expert Power Bond}

Allied creatues have 45% chance to deal 2 damage (per crature) after each melee attack. Creatures that cast spells have 1 additional cast.

mod.name: Andruids Expansion Mods
mod.description: Various modifications expanding Heroes III mechanics and elements. New creatures, skills, spells, objects and mechanics.
mod.damned utopia.name: Damned Utopia
mod.damned utopia.description: New creature bank. 'Dead Dragon Utopia' def was taken from fred's object pack, 'Blood Dragon' def was made by don_kommandore and 'Dracolich' by Wog Team.
mod.initiative.name: Battle Initiative
mod.initiative.description: This mod adds a new secondary skill that makes creatures move quicker in battle, but their movement distance stays the same.
mod.minotaur warlock.name: Minotaur Warlock
mod.minotaur warlock.description: A mod that adds a new animation for Dungeon Warlocks who are Minotaurs.
mod.minotaur warlock.new mino warlock.de: A mod that adds a new hero.
mod.plaguetent.name: Plague Tent
mod.plaguetent.description: A new War Machine for Necropolis Faction and a new Hero who starts and specialises with it. The Plague Tent casts accumulating disease or poison at the target enemy. It only works on living creatures!
mod.powerbond.name: Power Bond
mod.powerbond.description: This mod adds a new secondary skill, learnable only by magic-class heroes, that lets their troops use supernatural energy in melee combat and gives +1 cast to their spellcasters. Low-tier creatures benefit from the former bonus the most. Additionally, artifacts that boost this skill further can be found or bought from the Bonepeddler, and equipped by the creatures themselves.
